$comment: Converter graph for Module 2. Each edge is one conversion step. 'from' x 'to' expands to one edge per pair (or use 'pairs'). 'modes' gives the cost of the edge in each fidelity mode; an edge without a mode cannot be used in that mode. Lower cost = better fidelity. The planner picks the cheapest chain per (source, target, mode); 'overrides' pin a chain where the cheapest one is wrong. 'finalOnly' edges may only be the last step. 'losses' are step-specific losses on top of the format-capability losses the planner computes itself; use an object keyed by target id ('*' = all targets) when they differ per target. A loss can be {"text", "ifSourceHas": feature} to show it only when the source format can hold that feature.
